items.claim: slots: a drop from outside could make two siblings trade places once `arrive` ran
pack `'grow'`: the container stopped following its content on a reorder, a child resize or a width change
items.note: This adds an optional `LayoutStrategy.fit` hook to core, with a `minor` changeset because it is new API. The layout pass calls it wherever it called `childPoses`, and `createPerContainerStrategy` forwards it.

items.claim: tileGrid `'grow'`: in a multi-select drop into a full grid, the second member got a halved pitch, over a sibling
pack `'grow'`: a departure collapsed the container to `minHeight` when a remaining child was wider than it
tileGrid offered empty cells, then `childPoses` compacted the dropped child out of them
items.note: Strict call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: a child keeps its cell, and only a departure closes gaps. editing's drag-out preview now runs the source container's `depart`, as the commit does; it had relied on `childPoses` compacting.

items.claim: pack `'grow'` did not resize on a reordering drop or a width change
items.note: duplicate of the A pack-grow finding

items.claim: tileGrid `cols`/`rows` were not validated: 0 wrote `NaN` poses and a fraction laid cells off the grid
items.note: Strict call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: counts round down, and under 1 or not finite gives a grid with no cells, which refuses every child (`gridSlots`' rule).

items.claim: slots: a drop from outside swapped two existing children
items.note: duplicate of the A slots finding

items.claim: quadtree `maxDepth` was unbounded, with a 4^depth scan per child
items.note: Strict call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: `maxDepth` rounds down and is held to 0–7, and `NaN` gives the default 4. Free cells are now found by set lookup.
